description.text: Program Description Architecture is a discipline that focuses on learning how to design architecture while also learning relevant basic technology courses. Main content of learning is through the analysis of a blank space, at the same time, according to the construction of room function requirements, the type of building (such as gym, cinema, residential, factories and other different type), construction technology and materials used in the construction, from the plane of the building, the exterior facade and the design of internal and external space from scratch. The scope of study ranged from simple room layout to the design of architectural groups of several blocks in the city. Duration 5 years

duration.text: The Architecture at Shanghai University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4444 USD/per year ￥ 32000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.(at least 1 A4 page)
